rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God requites fabricators with wrath, expulsion, distance, and humiliation for claiming that worship of passion, worldly life, and desire cannot harm them.
rows.anchor: {وكذالك نجزى المفترين} يعني : وكذلك نجازي بالغضب والطرد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The evil deeds are sins of worshipping passion and worldly life and falsely attributing claims to God.
rows.anchor: يعني : سيئات عبادة الهوى والدنيا والافتراء على الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repentance and faith mean returning to servitude to the Real and sincerely seeking Him.
rows.anchor: بعبودية الحق تعالى وطلبه بالصدق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God forgives after abandoning worship of passion and returning to seek the Real, granting nearness and spiritual honors.
rows.anchor: أي : من بعد ترك عبادة الهوى والرجوع إلى طلب الحق {لغفور رحيم}

rows.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
rows.claim: The Ta'wilat al-Najmiyya interprets forgiveness as pardon of sins and mercy as attainment of divine nearness and spiritual honors.
rows.anchor: يعفو عنهم تلك السيئات ويرحمهم بنيل القربات والكرامات كذا في "التأويلات النجمية".

rows.speaker: المعتزلة
rows.claim: The Mu'tazilites regard repentance as a cause that necessarily brings forgiveness.
rows.anchor: التوبة عند المعتزلة علة موجبة للمغفرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author says repentance is only a means for forgiveness, not a necessary cause.
rows.anchor: وعندنا سبب محض للمغفرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repentance means return: for a servant it is turning from sin, while for God it means turning from punishment by forgiving.
rows.anchor: فإذا وصف بها العبد كان المراد بها الرجوع عن المعصية وإذا وصف بها الباري تعالى أريد بها الرجوع عن العذاب بالمغفرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repentance has outward and inward forms.
rows.anchor: والتوبة على ضربين : ظاهر وباطن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outward repentance leaves breaches of the outward law and uses the limbs in acts of obedience.
rows.anchor: ترك المخالفات واستعمال الجوارح بالطاعات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart repents of heedlessness by becoming constant in remembrance even when the tongue is still.
rows.anchor: والباطن : هو توبة القلب من ذنوب الباطن وهي الغفلة عن الذكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repentance of the lower self means severing worldly attachments, accepting little, and practicing restraint.
rows.anchor: وتوبة النفس قطع علائق الدنيا والأخذ باليسير والتعفف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Intellectual repentance consists of contemplating the inward meanings of signs and the traces of created things.
rows.anchor: وتوبة العقل التفكر في بواطن الآيات وآثار المصنوعات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spirit repents by acquiring divine knowledge, while the innermost secret turns toward the highest presence after turning from this world and the next.
rows.anchor: وتوبة الروح التحلي بالمعارف الإلهية ، وتوبة السر التوجه إلى الحضرة العليا

rows.speaker: حضرة جلال الدين الرومي
rows.claim: Rumi urges repentance for past deeds while life remains, presenting the present moment as the root of renewed life and repentance.
rows.anchor: قال حضرة جلال الدين الرومي قدس سره : كرسيه كردى تونامه عمر خويش توبه كن زانها كه كردستى تويشعمر اكر بكذشت بيخش اين دم است

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When a servant turns from evil and reforms his actions, God reforms his state and restores blessings that had passed away.
rows.anchor: والعبد إذا رجع عن السيئة وأصلح عمله أصلح الله تعالى شأنه وأعاد عليه نعمه الفائتة

rows.speaker: إبراهيم بن أدهم
rows.claim: Ibrahim ibn Adham relays a tale of an Israelite whose hand withered after slaughtering a calf before its mother, then was restored after he compassionately returned a fallen fledgling to its nest.
rows.anchor: عن إبراهيم بن أدهم : بلغني أن رجلا من بني إسرائيل ذبح عجلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers should hasten to repentance and righteous deeds, since good deeds erase evil deeds.
rows.anchor: فينبغي للمؤمن أن يسارع إلى التوبة والعمل الصالح فإن الحسنات يذهبن السيئات

rows.speaker: أبو ذر
rows.claim: Abu Dharr reports the Prophet's advice to follow a sin with a good deed, which is multiplied tenfold, and that declaring God's oneness is the best good deed.
rows.anchor: عن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه قال : قلت لرسول الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A Persian verse teaches that remembrance of God is the finest good action.
rows.anchor: كار نيكوتر بدان جز ذكر نيست …

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses' anger subsided after Aaron's apology and the people's repentance.
rows.anchor: لما سكن عنه الغضب باعتذار أخيه وتوبة القوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because silence literally entails ending speech and anger does not speak, the phrase is metaphorical: anger is personified as an instigator that stops urging Moses to punish Aaron and throw the tablets; this is a concealed metaphor.
rows.anchor: فهو محمول على المعنى المجازي الذي هو السكون شبه الغضب بإنسان يغري موسى عليه السلام

rows.speaker: الحدادي
rows.claim: Al-Haddadi reports an alternative inverted reading: Moses became silent from anger, like saying one put a cap into one's head to mean one's head into a cap.
rows.anchor: قال الحدادي : قيل معناه سكت موسى عن الغضب وهذا من المقلوب كما يقال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses' taking the tablets back proves they did not break and that none were removed, contrary to some commentators.
rows.anchor: {أخذ الالواح} التي ألقاها وهو دليل على أنها لم تتكسر حين ألقاها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nuskha means what was copied and written from an original, here the Preserved Tablet; copying transfers the written forms from one book to another.
rows.anchor: {وفى نسختها} أي : والحال إنه فيما نسخ فيها وكتب نقلا عن الأصل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Guidance means clarification of truth, and grammatically it is the subject whose predicate is the phrase in its inscription.
rows.anchor: {هدى} أي : بيان للحق وهو مبتدأ وفي نسختها خبره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tablets are mercy by guiding creatures to good and right action; the fearful benefit from scripture, and the preposition in 'for their Lord' strengthens a delayed verb.
rows.anchor: {ورحمة} للخلق بإرشادهم إلى ما فيه الخير والصلاح كائنة {للذين هم لربهم يرهبون}

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fearful are singled out because they benefit from scripture; the servant combines hope in God through sincere seeking and good works with fear of separation and hell.
rows.anchor: وإنما خص أهل الرهبة بالذكر لأنهم هم المنتفعون بآيات الكتاب فالعبد إذا رغب إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear of God grows from knowledge of His attributes; its sign is abandoning worldly attachments and struggling against the ego and Satan, since purification precedes adornment.
rows.anchor: أن الخشية إنما تنشأ عن العلم بصفات الحق سبحانه وعلامة خشية الله تعالى ترك الدنيا والخلق ومحاربة النفس والشيطان

rows.speaker: قالوا
rows.claim: A saying that fear is better than mercy is explained by the principle that purification comes before adornment.
rows.anchor: قالوا رهبوت خير من رحوت أي لأن ترهب خير من أن ترحم وذلك لأن التخلية قبل التحلية

rows.speaker: يحيى بن زكريا
rows.claim: A report says that after John once ate barley bread to fullness and slept through his nightly devotion, God warned that seeing either Paradise or Hell would overwhelm him with longing or grief.
rows.anchor: ما حكي عن يحيى بن زكريا عليهما السلام أنه شبع مرة من خبز شعير فنام عن حزبه تلك الليلة

rows.speaker: الحسن البصري
rows.claim: Hasan al-Basri says a dog that is beaten and driven off still responds gratefully to a morsel without holding a grudge; believers should imitate this trait of the God-fearing.
rows.anchor: قال الحسن البصري : الكلب إذا ضرب وطرد وجفى عليه وطرح له كسرة

rows.speaker: الحافظ
rows.claim: Hafiz's Persian verse says that in this spiritual path, resentment is tantamount to unbelief, so one should accept blame with good cheer.
rows.anchor: قال الحافظ : وفاكنيم وملامت كشيم وخوش باشيم كه در طريقت ما كافريست رنجيدن

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: A hadith says that whoever does not fear God will be feared by others; al-Sakhawi judges its meaning sound because lacking fear leads to every forbidden and disliked act.
rows.anchor: وفي الحديث : "من لم يخف الله خف منه" قال الإمام السخاوي معناه صحيح فإن عدم الخوف

rows.speaker: المثنوي
rows.claim: The Mathnawi says fear suits the fearful: God makes the one who fears safe and steadies the fearful heart, while the fearless person needs instruction.
rows.anchor: وفي "المثنوي" : لا تخافوا هست نزل خائقان هست درخور ازبراى خائف آن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ikhtara is a derived form of khayr and means to take the best or finest option.
rows.anchor: الاختيار افتعال من لفظ الخير ، يقال اختار الشيء إذا أخذ خيره وخياره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qawmahu means from his people, with the preposition omitted and the verb made transitive to the prepositional object; the phrase is a second object.
rows.anchor: {قومه} أي : من قومه بحذف الجار وإيصال الفعل إلى المجرور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses selected seventy of Israel's best men for the appointed time of repentance and apology for the calf worship, which was distinct from the appointment for divine conversation.
rows.anchor: {لميقاتنا} أي : للوقت الذي وقتناه له وعيناه ليأتي فيه بسبعين رجلا من خيار بني إسرائيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses chose seventy men for each of the two appointments; selecting six from each of twelve tribes yielded seventy-two, so two were to stay, and Caleb and Joshua stayed after Moses promised them the same reward.
rows.anchor: وكان قد اختار موسى عليه السلام عند الخروج إلى كل من الميقاتين سبعين رجلا من قومه وكانوا اثني عشر سبطا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountain quake struck after they rashly demanded to see God openly, as in the earlier account; the violent shaking caused them to faint or die.
rows.anchor: {فلمآ أخذتهم الرجفة} مما اجترأوا عليه من طلب الرؤية حيث قالوا : {لن نؤمن لك حتى نرى الله جهرة}

rows.speaker: أكثر المفسرين
rows.claim: Most commentators say the people heard God speak to Moses, commanding them to kill themselves in repentance, and then became desirous of seeing God.
rows.anchor: وأكثر المفسرين على أنهم سمعوه تعالى يكلم موسى يأمره بقتل أنفسهم توبة فطمعوا في الرؤية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author rejects that account by citing God's special selection of Moses for messages and speech, following the position in al-Taysir.
rows.anchor: ويرده قوله تعالى : يا موسى إنى اصطفيتك على الناس برسالاتي وبكلامي}

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses says God could have destroyed the people earlier when they failed to restrain calf worship and did not leave its persistent worshippers, and could have destroyed him too when he asked for vision; he recalls prior pardon to seek pardon again.
rows.anchor: {قال} موسى {رب لو شئت أهلكتهم من قبل} أي : حين فرطوا في النهي عن عبادة العجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The interrogative denies that God will destroy them, out of confidence in His gentleness: Moses means, do not destroy us.
rows.anchor: {أتهلكنا} الهمزة لإنكار وقوع الإهلاك ثقة بلطف الله تعالى ، أي : لا تهلكنا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about what the fools did can be read as Moses pleading that it is unfitting to destroy a large group for an offense committed by a few rash people who demanded vision.
rows.anchor: {بما فعل السفهآء} حال كونهم {منآ} من العناد والتجاسر على طلب الرؤية ، وكأن ذلك قاله بعضهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The trial was God's test: after hearing His speech, the people failed to verify and were tempted to demand vision.
rows.anchor: {إلا فتنتك} أي : محنتك وابتلاؤك حيث أسمعتهم كلامك فافتتنوا بذلك ولم يتثبتوا فطمعوا في الرؤية.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their hearing God's speech was a test rather than an honorific audience, which does not diminish Moses' chosen status; Moses' hearing differed greatly from theirs.
rows.anchor: هذا يدل على أنهم سمعوا كلامه تعالى على وجه الامتحان والابتلاء لا على وجه الكرمة والإجلال

rows.speaker: فصل الخطاب
rows.claim: A mystical account says God placed Moses in spiritual expansion until intimacy matured, so his daring arose from the boldness of the beloved, which belongs to the rank of love.
rows.anchor: ودر فصل الخطاب مذكورست كه حق تعالى موسى عليه السلام را در مقام بسط بداشت تابكمال حال انس رسيده

rows.speaker: حضرت مولوي
rows.claim: Mawlana says the lover's boldness is not a breach of courtesy but its very essence, because lovers' speech is driven by love in God's service.
rows.anchor: وحضرت مولوي قدس سره فرموده كه كستاخى عاشق ترك أدب نيست بلكه عين ادبست

rows.speaker: حضرت مولوي
rows.claim: Mawlana's couplets say divine intimacy overwhelms ordinary etiquette and reason in one who tastes a draught from God's cup.
rows.anchor: كفت وكوى عاشقان دركار رب جوشش عشقست نه ترك أدب هركه كردازجام حق يكجرعه نوش

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The trial makes some stray by exceeding their limits in demanding what they cannot have, while it guides others to truth and strengthens their faith.
rows.anchor: {تضل بها} أي : بسبب تلك الفتنة {من تشآء} ضلاله فيتجاوز عن حده بطلب ما ليس له {وتهدى من تشآء}

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone manages the people's worldly and otherworldly affairs, protects them, and supports them.
rows.anchor: {أنت ولينا} أي : القائم بأمورنا الدنيوية والأخروية وناصرنا وحافظنا لا غير.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks God to forgive what they committed and to send worldly and otherworldly effects of mercy.
rows.anchor: {فاغفر لنا} أي : ما اقترفناه من المعاصي. {وارحمنآ} بإفاضة آثار الرحمة الدنيوية والأخروية.

rows.speaker: ابن الشيخ
rows.claim: Ibn al-Shaykh distinguishes forgiveness as removing punishment from mercy as delivering good; forgiveness comes first because preventing harm precedes gaining benefit.
rows.anchor: قال ابن الشيخ : المغفرة هي إسقاط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is the best forgiver because He both forgives sin and replaces it with good deeds.
rows.anchor: تغفر السيئة وتبدلها بالحسنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other people forgive for praise, reward, or relief from hardness of heart, but God forgives purely through grace; forgiveness is emphasized as most important in this context.
rows.anchor: وأما أنت فتغفر ذنوب عبادك لا لأجل غرض وعوض بل بمحض الفضل والكرم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Writing means to establish and appoint something for them, and the wording is used because written things endure longer.
rows.anchor: {واكتب لنا} أي : أثبت وعين لنا وذكر الكتابة لأنها أدوم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The requested good in this world is a good livelihood and success in obedience; the good in the next world is the best reward or Paradise.
rows.anchor: {فى هاذه الدنيا حسنة} حسن معيشة وتوفيق طاعة. {وفي الاخرة} أي : واكتب لنا فيها أيضا حسنة وهي المثوبة الحسنى أو الجنة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The declaration of return explains their request for pardon and mercy: they repented of the grave sin and the demand for vision, so refusing repentant people would contradict divine kindness.
rows.anchor: {إنا هدنآ إليك} تعليل لطلب الغفران والرحمة من هاد يهود إذا رجع ، أي تبنا ورجعنا إليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some say all the people died when the quake seized them and Moses implored God until He restored them to life, as discussed in al-Baqara.
rows.anchor: قيل : لما أخذتهم الرجفة ماتوا جميعا فأخذ موسى عليه السلام يتضرع إلى الله حتى أحياهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement by God is a rhetorical resumption answering the implied question of what God said after Moses' supplication.
rows.anchor: {قال} استئناف بياني ، كأنه قيل فماذا قال الله تعالى عند دعاء موسى عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God says He inflicts punishment on whomever He wills to punish, without anyone else having a role in it.
rows.anchor: {عذابى} (عذاب من وصفت إو آنست كه) {أصيب به} الباء للتعدية معناه بالفارسية (ميرسانم) {من أشآء} تعذيبه من غير دخل لغيري فيه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine mercy reaches every kind of being in this world, believer or unbeliever, accountable or not; all live by its blessings, but in the hereafter mercy is exclusive to believers.
rows.anchor: {ورحمتى} (ورحمت من وصفت أو آنست كه) {وسعت} في الدنيا معناه (رسيده است) {كل شىء} المؤمن والكافر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Writing mercy means establishing and appointing it for the hereafter.
rows.anchor: كما قال تعالى : {فسأكتبها} أي : أثبتها وأعينها في الآخرة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who fear are those who avoid unbelief and sins; zakat is singled out because it was especially difficult for them.
rows.anchor: {للذين يتقون} الكفر والمعاصي. {ويؤتون الزكواة} خصها بالذكر لأنها كانت أشق عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Belief in God's signs is continuous and does not reject any of them.
rows.anchor: يؤمنون} إيمانا مستمرا فلا يكفرون بشيء منها.

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas reports that Iblis claimed inclusion when the verse was revealed, then Jews and Christians claimed they met its conditions; God excluded them through the verse's later qualification.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما : لما أنزلت هذه الآية تطاول لها إبليس فقال : أنا شيء من الأشياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two fingers signify God's attributes of beauty and majesty; the human heart uniquely reflects them, producing love and longing under beauty or worldly desire under majesty.
rows.anchor: وبالأصبعين يشير إلى صفتي الجمال والجلال وليس لغير الإنسان قلب مخصوص بهذه الكرامة وإقامة القلب وإزاغته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses' heart was specially chosen for message and divine speech, so his request to see arose with proper humility and nearness; the people's heedless demand put denial first and displayed bad manners.
rows.anchor: فالنكتة فيه أن قلب موسى عليه السلام لما كان مخصوصا بالاصطفاء للرسالة والكلام دون القوم كان سؤاله لرؤية شعلة نار المحبة مقرونا بحفظ الأدب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses' collapse was a gracious manifestation of lordship, while the people's quake was an overpowering manifestation of might and majesty.
rows.anchor: فشتان بين صعقه موسى وصعقة قومه فإن صعقته كانت صعقة اللطف مع تجلى صفة الربوبية ، وإن صعقتهم كانت صعقة القهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Established in unity, Moses saw all things as coming from God and understood the people's folly and the effects of divine power as their test; in spiritual intimacy he then spoke of God's trial.
rows.anchor: ولما كان موسى عليه السلام ثابتا في مقام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the mystical reading, God causes a heart to deviate by the finger of the attribute of overpowering might and steadies another by the finger of gentleness.
rows.anchor: أي : تزيغ قلب من تشاء بأصبع صفة القهر {وتهدى من تشآء} أي : تقيم قلب من تشاء بأصبع صفة اللطف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks for mercy through the blessing of the vision they had requested.
rows.anchor: {وارحمنآ} بنعمة الرؤية التي سألناكها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is the best concealer of sinners' faults: others conceal sins without granting the request, whereas God conceals, replaces sins with good deeds, and grants the requests of sinners.
rows.anchor: فأنت الذي تستر الذنب وتبدله بالحسنات وتعطي سؤل أهل الزلات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The requested good in this world is the vision granted to Muhammad and his elect community, and Moses asks for this favor in this life and the next.
rows.anchor: {واكتب لنا فى هاذه الدنيا حسنة} يعني : حسنة الرؤية كما كتبت لمحمد عليه السلام ولخواص أمته هذه الحسنة في الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They say they have returned secretly to seek this spiritual favor, since God knows what is secret and more hidden, and He answers them in the same secret and implicit manner.
rows.anchor: رجعنا إليك في طلب هذه الفضيلة بالسر لا بالعلانية وأنت الذي تعلم السر والأخفى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about punishment means God takes people by His attribute of wrath; an alternate reading, man asa'a, means He takes whoever behaved badly in the etiquette of requesting vision and disciplines them with separation.
rows.anchor: وبقراءة من قرأ من أساء ، أي : من أساء في الأدب عند سؤال الرؤية حيث قالوا لن نؤمن لك حتى نرى الله جهرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The encompassing mercy is interpreted as blessing, bringing beings into existence, and nurturing them.
rows.anchor: {ورحمتى وسعت كل شىء} نعمة وإيجادا وتربية.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promised writing refers to the good of vision and the mercy that comes through it, which Moses and his people request.
rows.anchor: {فسأكتبها} يعني : حسنة الرؤية والرحمة بها التي أنتم تسألونها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the mystical interpretation, fearing means relying on God against all else, while giving zakat means offering the due share of this spiritual station to its seekers.
rows.anchor: {للذين يتقون ويؤتون الزكواة} يعني : يتقون بالله عن غيره ويؤتون من نصاب هذا المقام الزكاة إلى طلابه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The faithful are the elect who believe through the lights of witnessing signs with verified insight rather than imitation.
rows.anchor: الذين هم يؤمنون بأنوار شواهد الآيات لا بالتقليد بل بالتحقيق وهم خواص هذه الأمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The description of followers of the unlettered Prophet signals that some in his community can follow him through three stations: messengerhood, shared prophethood, and his unique unlettered station.
rows.anchor: وفيه إشارة إلى أن في أمته من يكون مستعدا لاتباعه في هذه المقامات الثلاثة ، وهي : مقامات الرسالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author interprets ummi as the mother and origin of created things, like Mecca as the origin of towns and the Mother of the Book as the origin of books, citing sayings that the Prophet's spirit was first created and the cosmos was created for him.
rows.anchor: ومعنى الأمي : أنه أم الموجودات وأصل المكونات كما قال : "أول ما خلق الله روحي"

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Following the Messenger means taking what he gives and avoiding what he forbids; messengerhood concerns outward law, while prophethood concerns inward states, so common people share the former and elect people the latter.
rows.anchor: فبأن يأخذ ما آتاه الرسول وينتهي عما نهاه عنه كما قال تعالى : {ومآ ءاتااكم الرسول فخذوه وما نهااكم عنه فانتهوا}

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fulfilling outward legal duties opens inward prophetic states such as true inspiration, dreams, angelic voices, and potentially conversation, vision, and unveiling; such people call others by following the Prophet, not independently.
rows.anchor: فمن أدى حقوق أحكام الرسالة في الظاهر يفتتح له بها أحوال النبوة في الباطن من مقام تنبئة الحق تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The saying that scholars of Muhammad's community are like the prophets of Israel points to the elect who attain these inward states through following the Prophet.
rows.anchor: كما قال عليه السلام : "علماء أمتي كأنبياء بني إسرائيل" يشير إلى هذا القوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering what the scripture contains includes verbal remembrance and outward memorization, though acting on it is the main purpose.
rows.anchor: قوله تعالى : {واذكروا ما فيه} يتناول الذكر اللفظي والحفظ الظاهري وإن كان العمدة هي العمل

rows.speaker: سعدي
rows.claim: Saadi says the Qur'an was revealed to cultivate good character, not merely to recite its written chapters; the scholar who neglects it is like a sleeping rider.
rows.anchor: كما قال سعدي قدس سره : (مراد از نزول قرآن تحصيل سيرت خوبست نه ترتيل سوره مكتوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage tells Muhammad to recall to the Children of Israel when God took their covenant from Adam's descendants.
rows.anchor: {وإذ أخذ ربك} أي : واذكر يا محمد لبني إسرائيل وقت أخذ ربك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Children of Adam means Adam and his offspring, a name for the human kind; the intended descendants are those who would have children, excluding the infertile, unmarried, or those who died young.
rows.anchor: أي : آدم وأولاده كأنه صار اسما للنوع كالإنسان والبشر والمراد بهم الذين ولد لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their backs means their fathers' loins, indicating that the covenant was taken while they remained in their fathers' loins, before being placed in mothers' wombs.
rows.anchor: {من ظهورهم} بدل من بني آدم بدل البعض ، أي من أصلابهم وفيه تنبيه على أن الميثاق قد أخذ منهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their offspring is the object of taking: God brought generations from one another through the succession of loins, wombs, periods, and stages until the last child born.
rows.anchor: {ذريتهم} مفعول أخذ ، أي : نسلهم قرنا بعد قرن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each descendant was made to testify for himself, not another, establishing God's complete lordship, exclusive servitude, and its associated obligations.
rows.anchor: {وأشهدهم على أنفسهم} أي : أشهد كل واحد من أولئك الذريات المخصوصين المأخوذين من ظهور آبائهم على نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Am I not your Lord is spoken with an implied verb of saying and means the absolute master and nurturer of their affairs, with no one else involved.
rows.anchor: {ألست بربكم} على إرادة القول ، أي : قائلا ألست بربكم ومالك أمركم ومربيكم على الإطلاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their answer, yes, we testify, affirms that God is their Lord and deity and that they have no other lord.
rows.anchor: {بلى شهدنآ} أي : على أنفسنا بأنك ربنا وإلهنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bala affirms what follows a negative and thus means you are our Lord, whereas naam confirms the preceding negative and would mean you are not our Lord, hence disbelief.
rows.anchor: والفرق بين بلى ونعم أن بلى إثبات لما بعد النفي ، أي : أنت ربنا فيكون إيمانا ونعم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The scene is figurative: signs in the horizons and souls and an innate capacity for knowledge are represented as testimony-taking, and their recognition as confession; no literal extraction or dialogue occurred.
rows.anchor: وهذا تمثيل وتخييل نزل تمكينهم من العلم بربوبيته بنصب الدلائل الآفاقية والأنفسية وخلق الاستعداد فيهم منزلة الإشهاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's address to heaven and earth and their obedient reply illustrate how figurative representation is common in scripture, hadith, and eloquent speech.
rows.anchor: قال الله تعالى : {فقال لها وللارض ائتيا طوعا أو كرها قالتآ أتينا طآااعين}

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The covenant prevents people from pleading at resurrection that they were unaware of God's oneness and its obligations, since their innate disposition and latent knowledge leave them no such excuse.
rows.anchor: {أن تقولوا} مفعول له لما قبله من الأخذ والإشهاد ، أي فعلنا ما فعلنا كراهة

rows.speaker: حواشي سعدى لبى
rows.claim: The Hashiyat Sa'di Labi argues that even if the testimony were literal and God later erased its memory, people still could not say they were unaware.
rows.anchor: كما في "حواشي سعدى لبى" المفتي.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The excuse that their fathers invented idolatry and descendants merely followed them is described as a claim that their ancestors introduced shirk and the children could neither find guidance nor reason independently.
rows.anchor: {أو تقولوا إنمآ أشرك ءابآؤنا} عطف على أن تقولوا واو لمنع الخلو دون الجمع أي : اخترعوا الإشراك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their question asks whether they should be punished for what errant ancestors did, while portraying themselves as incapable of independent judgment.
rows.anchor: {أفتهلكنا} أي : أتؤاخذنا فتهلكنا {بما فعل المبطلون} من آبائنا المضلين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their full capacity to recognize and use evidence, already established above, also blocks the excuse of following ancestors, since imitation after proof is impermissible.
rows.anchor: فإن التقليد بعد قيام الدلائل والقدرة على الاستدلال بها مما لا مساغ له أصلا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: And thus refers to the source of the following verb and is accusative as a verbal noun, meaning such detailed explanation that yields great benefits.
rows.anchor: {وكذالك} إشارة إلى مصدر الفعل المذكور بعده ومحله النصب على المصدرية ، أي مثل ذلك التفصيل البليغ

rows.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
rows.claim: The Ta'wilat al-Najmiyya distinguishes created taking, which draws an existing thing from an existing thing, from God's creation of what is nonexistent out of nonexistence, as in the covenant scene.
rows.anchor: في الآية إشارة إلى أن أخذ المخلوقين يكون أخذ الشيء الموجود من الشيء الموجود وأن أخذ الخالق تارة هو أخذ الشيء المعدوم من العدم

rows.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
rows.claim: God brought into existence the nonexistent progeny, backs, and ancestors by His power, giving them an existence suited to that primordial state.
rows.anchor: فكان بنو آدم معدومين وظهورهم معدومين وذرياتهم معدومين فأخذ بكمال قدرته ذرياتهم المعدومة إلى يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
rows.claim: God extracted particles of descendants from Adam and successive loins; souls then stood in three ranks: the forerunners, the people of the right, and the people of the left.
rows.anchor: والأرواح في تلك الحالة جنود مجندة في ثلاثة صفوف : الصف الأول : أرواح السابقين

rows.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
rows.claim: The forerunners heard God spiritually, witnessed His beauty, loved Him, answered from love, and pledged to love and worship Him alone.
rows.anchor: فسمع السابقون بسمع نوراني روحاني خطابه وشاهدوا بأبصار نورانية جماله وأحبوه بأفئدة روحانية ربانية نورانية

rows.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
rows.claim: The people of the right heard and witnessed spiritually, believed, answered as servants, and pledged to worship God alone.
rows.anchor: وسمع أصحاب الميمنة بسمع روحاني خطابه وطالعوا بأبصار

rows.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
rows.claim: The people of the left heard from behind the veil of divine might, with blocked ears, veiled sight, and sealed hearts, and answered reluctantly under a covenant of servitude.
rows.anchor: وسمع أصحاب المشأمة خطابه بسمع روحاني من وراء حجاب العزة ، وفي آذانهم وقر الغرة

rows.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
rows.claim: Differences between disbelief and faith among people ultimately reflect differences in their spiritual and divine preparedness.
rows.anchor: فالآن يرجع التفاوت بين الخليقة في الكفر والإيمان إلى تفاوت الاستعدادات الروحانية والربانية
